rationale: manhart_pwls_tv-claude-agentic: val_n=200, pwls_gamma=1.0, pwls_weight_norm=mean, tv_lambda=0.003, tv_iterations=1200, tv_lr=0.01, tv_decay=0.01, tv_optimizer=gd, tv_init=fbp, rationale=iter-13 CONVERGENCE at the peak config. Both late-step levers destabilize: iter-11 lr 0.01->0.02 -> hr 0.2396, iter-12 decay 0.01->0.001 -> hr 0.0826. So GD lr=0.01, decay=0.01 is the stable schedule; revert both. Earlier GD logs show the TV term STILL descending at iter-1000 (under-converged) but larger steps oscillate. The stable way to converge further is MORE iterations at the safe schedule. ONE knob: tv_iterations 1000->1200 (keep gd, lambda=3e-3, lr=0.01, decay=0.01, gamma=1.0). HYPOTHESIS: 200 more stable GD iters converge TV further so hr rises past 0.3596; if saturated, GD/TV has converged and 0.3596 is the plateau. Budget: iter-9 868s at 1000 iters -> ~1040s at 1200, still <1200s wall.
